import json, os, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from test_e2e import build
from test_fuzz import coherent_campaign, build_capture
import random
jobs = [build()]
for seed in (3, 11, 29):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    job, lookup, lows, rows = coherent_campaign(rnd)
    job['captures'] = [build_capture(rnd, rows, safe=True)]
    jobs.append(job)
outs = []
for run in range(3):
    batch = []
    for job in jobs:
        env = dict(os.environ, TMPDIR='/workspace/tmp')
        p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/campaign.py'],
                           input=json.dumps(job).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                           stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, cwd='/workspace/tmp', env=env)
        assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr
        batch.append(p.stdout)
    outs.append(batch)
same = all(outs[0] == o for o in outs[1:])
print('deterministic across 3 runs:', same)
if not same:
    for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(outs[0], outs[1])):
        if a != b: print('job', i, 'differs'); print(a[:400]); print(b[:400])
PY
